name: Maid Service Trapdoor!
source:
Service Trapdoor a upcoming visual novel parodying early Otokonoko and Gender Bender manga of the 90s and early 2000s, exploring  and subverting some of the classic tropes of the genre.

It starts as it usually does, our MC (Ginger with Glasses), infiltrates an All Girls School to finally be closer with his childhood friend, and love of his life Gabrielle (blue hair)

 ...But somehow he ends up working at this Maid Cafe, Cafe Trapdoor?! ran by some guy named Big Brother?! (Yellow suit and staring at me) 

Along with Sensei (glasses) and Tsun (Bunny wabbit), Will you go after the girl you came here for, or will someone else steal your heart instead? 

Or, was this even a good idea?

Is this cafe really what it seems?

[From [url=https://saturn-murray.itch.io/maidservicetrapdoor]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Service Trapdoor是一部即将推出的视觉小说，戏仿90年代和2000年代初的《Otokonoko》和《Gender Bender》漫画，探索并颠覆了该类型的一些经典比喻。

一如往常，我们的主持人（戴眼镜的金杰）潜入一所女子学校，最终与他儿时的朋友、他一生的挚爱加布里埃尔（蓝发）拉近了距离

 ……但不知怎的，他最终在这家女仆咖啡厅，Cafe Trapdoor工作？！被一个叫老大哥的家伙操纵了？！（黄西装盯着我看）与老师（眼镜）和津（兔子）一起，你会去追寻你来这里的女孩，还是会被别人偷走你的心？

或者，这是个好主意吗？

这家咖啡馆真的像看上去的那样吗？

[来自[url=https://saturn-murray.itch.io/maidservicetrapdoor]itch.io[/url]]
